description: Create a campaign in draft status with its opening SMS. THIS SENDS NOTHING — a draft cannot deliver a message. It exists so a human can read the exact wording and audience before deciding. The message is rejected if it implies a prior relationship or manufactures urgency. After this, call review_campaign_readiness.

description.description: Context for the operator: who this targets and why.

idempotency_key.description: Repeat a retried call safely — the same key returns the same campaign.

lead_ids.description: Existing leads to move into this campaign. Ids outside this account are ignored.

message.description: The opening SMS, 320 characters or fewer. Say who is writing and why. Do not imply a prior conversation or a deadline. An opt-out line is appended automatically on first contact.

name.description: A name the operator will recognise in their dashboard.

outreach_vertical.description: Who the recipients ARE. 'home_purchase' — homeowners who might sell. 'b2b' — businesses and operators in the industry, never contacted about a house they live in. This chooses the copy rules AND which registered number the campaign may text from, so set it here rather than later: a b2b campaign left unset is treated as homeowner outreach. Omit it only when the campaign genuinely is homeowner outreach or you do not know.

name: create_campaign_draft
title: Create a campaign draft
